recentItems.title: Adding £1000s In Value To 3 Disastrous UK Wrecks | Worst House on the Street
recentItems.description:
Three extreme house transformations. Three nightmare properties. One massive challenge.

In this Series 1 Part 2 compilation of Worst House on the Street, Scarlette and Stuart take on three of the most challenging property transformations yet, helping ambitious UK renovators turn derelict, damp-riddled wrecks into high-value dream homes on razor-thin budgets.

Watch as three desperate UK properties get completely overhauled to unlock massive property value:

Episode 4 Bristol: Sana tackles a severely dated, damp-riddled first home with cracked windows and a jungle for a garden.

Episode 5 Swansea: Laura and Tim overhaul a completely derelict, eyesore cottage into a stunning home with a luxury boutique bathroom.

Episode 6 Bedfordshire: Kelly and Andrew transform a ramshackle rural house with a modern, open-plan kitchen-diner.
